name: The Warden
concept: A grappler with chains, on one 26-card deck, and no combos: he hits hard when a grab lands. Grabs beat Guards, every grab chips 5 or 6, and every Counter he holds is a grab, so his punishes hit hard too. Shakedown and Coil take a card, Shackles cuts their hand to 5, Chain Toss is a Safe poke; his specials are Iron Haul and Chain Whip, and Chain Prison cuts their hand to 3.

cards.name: Haul In
cards.flavour: Drag them in before they can set.

cards.name: Shackles
cards.flavour: Chained up, you can't carry much.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavour: Cover up and build the bar.

cards.name: Iron Haul
cards.flavour: The chain finds you before you move.

cards.name: Chain Whip
cards.flavour: A crack of the chain from out of reach.

notes: Rules v18. 8 November 2026 (later), Mark: a grappler, not a combo fighter: no combo icons, and his grabs hit hard (+3 chip: Shakedown, Haul In, Shackles, Iron Haul 5; Coil, Chain Prison 6). Against the 7 November Benchmark: 50.8% (51.1%, 50.5%; two seeds of 400). Mirror 49%, median 12, 1% time-outs. But he beats Vex 73% (66% with Vex at HP 32). The previous deck (3 Starters, grabs as before) is variants/warden-26-toss-b3c2.json. Rules v18. 8 November 2026 (afternoon): Chain Toss is Safe with no icons (Mark: a long-range move isn't a combo starter), and Build 3, chip 2 like the Benchmark's Shot. Against the 7 November Benchmark: 41.8% (42.3%, 41.3%; two seeds of 400); 37.3% at Build 2, chip 1; 46.9% as a Safe Starter (variants/warden-26-safetoss-starter.json); at HP 34, 45.1%. Also 8 November: 26 cards to match the other fighters (Mark), adding Haul In x1 (cut to fit 24 on 3 November) and a third Ankle Hook: Pressure 9, Convert 10, Recover 7. In sim against the 7 November Benchmark it changed nothing (44.2% at 24 and at 26, two seeds of 400); the 24-card deck is variants/warden-24.json. 3 November: the shared defence core (Recall, Charge, Read); Chain Toss and Chain Spin are plain attacks now. HP 32: against the HP 34 (3 November) Benchmark he won 41% at 30, 49% at 32 and 57% at 34 in sim.
